Particular attention is paid to Russian developments (the Groza family of stations) and foreign systems (Archer manufactured by Ultra I&C). A comparative analysis of tropospheric communications with alternative technologies – satellite, radio relay, and fiber-optic communications – is conducted. The advantages and limitations of the tropospheric method in Arctic conditions are identified.
